using Azure.Core;
using Azure.Identity;
using Hashbrown.AspNetCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;

var failures = new List<string>();
foreach (var api in new[] { "responses", "chat-completions" })
{
    foreach (var provider in new[] { "openai", "azure" })
    foreach (var explicitMode in new string?[] { null, "api-key" })
    {
        var values = Configuration(api, provider);
        values["ApiKey"] = "fixture-only-key";
        values["AzureAuthentication"] = explicitMode;
        values["ModelEndpoint"] = "http://127.0.0.1:1/";

        using var client = ProviderFactory.Create(Build(values), new ProviderClientComposition(_ => throw new Exception("API-key mode constructed an identity.")));

        Check(client is not null, $"{api}/{provider} key mode failed dry construction.");
    }
    foreach (var mode in new[] { "azure-cli", "managed-identity" })
    {
        var values = Configuration(api);
        values["AzureAuthentication"] = mode;

        try { using var client = ProviderFactory.Create(Build(values)); }
        catch (InvalidOperationException) { failures.Add($"{api}/{mode} keyless identity construction rejected."); }
    }
    foreach (var changes in new Dictionary<string, string?>[]
    {
        new() { ["ModelApi"] = "unknown", ["AzureAuthentication"] = "azure-cli" },
        new() { ["Provider"] = "unknown", ["AzureAuthentication"] = "azure-cli" },
        new() { ["Model"] = "", ["AzureAuthentication"] = "azure-cli" },
        new() { ["ModelEndpoint"] = "relative/path", ["AzureAuthentication"] = "azure-cli" },
        new() { ["ModelEndpoint"] = "ftp://fixture.example/", ["AzureAuthentication"] = "azure-cli" },
        new() { ["AzureAuthentication"] = "" },
        new() { ["AzureAuthentication"] = "default" },
        new() { ["AzureAuthentication"] = "AZURE-CLI" },
        new() { ["Provider"] = "openai", ["AzureAuthentication"] = "azure-cli" },
        new() { ["Provider"] = "openai", ["AzureAuthentication"] = "managed-identity" },
        new() { ["ManagedIdentityClientId"] = "user-client" },
        new() { ["AzureAuthentication"] = "azure-cli", ["ManagedIdentityClientId"] = "user-client" },
        new() { ["AzureAuthentication"] = "managed-identity", ["ManagedIdentityClientId"] = "" },
        new() { ["AzureAuthentication"] = "managed-identity", ["ManagedIdentityClientId"] = " " },
        new() { ["AzureAuthentication"] = "azure-cli", ["ModelEndpoint"] = "http://127.0.0.1:1/" },
        new() { ["AzureAuthentication"] = "managed-identity", ["ModelEndpoint"] = "http://127.0.0.1:1/" },
        new() { ["ModelEndpoint"] = "https://user:password@fixture.example/" },
        new() { ["ModelEndpoint"] = "https://fixture.example/?query=value" },
        new() { ["ModelEndpoint"] = "https://fixture.example/#fragment" },
        new() { ["ApiKey"] = "" },
        new() { ["ApiKey"] = " " },
    })
    {
        var values = Configuration(api);
        values["ApiKey"] = "fixture-only-key";
        foreach (var change in changes) values[change.Key] = change.Value;
        var rejected = false;

        var constructions = 0;
        var composition = new ProviderClientComposition(_ => { constructions++; throw new Exception("Invalid configuration constructed a credential."); });
        try { using var client = ProviderFactory.Create(Build(values), composition); }
        catch (InvalidOperationException) { rejected = true; }
        catch (ArgumentException) { rejected = true; }

        Check(constructions == 0, "Rejected configuration constructed an identity.");
        Check(rejected, $"{api} accepted invalid configuration: {string.Join(',', changes.Keys)}.");
    }
}
Check(new ProviderAuthentication("azure-cli", null).CreateCredential() is AzureCliCredential, "CLI must use AzureCliCredential.");
Check(new ProviderAuthentication("managed-identity", null).CreateCredential() is ManagedIdentityCredential, "System MI must use ManagedIdentityCredential.");
Check(new ProviderAuthentication("managed-identity", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001").CreateCredential() is ManagedIdentityCredential, "User MI must use ManagedIdentityCredential.");
if (failures.Count != 0) throw new Exception(string.Join(Environment.NewLine, failures));
Console.WriteLine("Native authentication configuration passed.");

void Check(bool condition, string message) { if (!condition) failures.Add(message); }
Dictionary<string, string?> Configuration(string api, string provider = "azure") => new()
{
    ["Provider"] = provider, ["ModelApi"] = api,
    ["ModelEndpoint"] = "https://fixture.example/", ["Model"] = "deployment"
};
IConfiguration Build(Dictionary<string, string?> values) => new ConfigurationBuilder().AddInMemoryCollection(values).Build();
